proof_body:
by
  intro A _ I J
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨K, hK⟩
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hcon
    obtain ⟨x, hxI, hxJ⟩ := SetLike.not_le_iff_exists.mp h1
    obtain ⟨y, hyJ, hyI⟩ := SetLike.not_le_iff_exists.mp h2
    have hxK : x ∈ K := by rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, hK]; exact Or.inl hxI
    have hyK : y ∈ K := by rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, hK]; exact Or.inr hyJ
    have hs : x + y ∈ (K : Set A) := K.add_mem hxK hyK
    rw [hK] at hs
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · exact hyI ((I.add_mem_iff_right hxI).mp hs)
    · exact hxJ ((J.add_mem_iff_left hyJ).mp hs)
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact ⟨J, by rw [Set.union_eq_self_of_subset_left h]⟩
    · exact ⟨I, by rw [Set.union_eq_self_of_subset_right h]⟩
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [Ring A] (I J : Ideal A), (∃ K : Ideal A, (K : Set A) = (I : Set A) ∪ (J : Set A)) ↔ I ≤ J ∨ J ≤ I
